#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
    long long capacity, flow;
    long long cost;
    long long remaining() { return capacity - flow; }
    Edge() {}
    Edge(int _u, int _v, long long _cap, long long _flow, long long _cost)
        : u(_u), v(_v), capacity(_cap), flow(_flow), cost(_cost) {}
};

int total_nodes;
vector<int> graph[8200];
vector<Edge> edges;

void addEdge(int u, int v, long long cap, long long cost) {
    graph[u].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.emplace_back(u, v, cap, 0, cost);
    graph[v].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.emplace_back(v, u, 0, 0, -cost);
}

long long dist[8200], minCost;
int predecessor[8200];
long long capacity[8200], maxFlow;
bool inQueue[8200];

void minCostFlow(int start, int end) {
    memset(inQueue, 0, sizeof(inQueue));
    maxFlow = minCost = 0;
    while (true) {
        fill(dist, dist + total_nodes, 1e15);
        dist[start] = 0;
        memset(predecessor, -1, sizeof(predecessor));
        predecessor[start] = 0;
        memset(capacity, 0, sizeof(capacity));
        capacity[start] = 1e15;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(start);
        inQueue[start] = true;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            inQueue[u] = false;
            for (int idx : graph[u]) {
                Edge &e = edges[idx];
                if (e.remaining() > 0 && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + e.cost + 1e-9) {
                    dist[e.v] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                    predecessor[e.v] = idx;
                    capacity[e.v] = min(capacity[u], e.remaining());
                    if (!inQueue[e.v]) {
                        q.push(e.v);
                        inQueue[e.v] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (predecessor[end] < 0) break;
        maxFlow += capacity[end];
        minCost += capacity[end] * dist[end];
        for (int v = end; v != start; v = edges[predecessor[v]].u) {
            edges[predecessor[v]].flow += capacity[end];
            edges[predecessor[v] ^ 1].flow -= capacity[end];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x; cin >> x; x--;
        addEdge(0, x + 1, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int x, y; cin >> x >> y; x--; y--;
        for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                addEdge(i * n + x + 1, (i + 1) * n + y + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                addEdge(i * n + y + 1, (i + 1) * n + x + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            addEdge(i * n + j + 1, (i + 1) * n + j + 1, 51, c);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
        addEdge(i * n + 1, 105 * n + 1, 51, 0);
    }
    total_nodes = 6 + 107 * n;
    minCostFlow(0, 105 * n + 1);
    cout << minCost << "\n";
    return 0;
